evidence: Lacks mempool label but has 'TX fees and policy' label and directly modifies fee estimation logic in src/policy/fees/
rationale: Fixes severe fee underestimation and failure to produce fee estimates when the mempool estimator is unavailable or sparse. When empty or sparse, the mempool estimator returned the fee floor, causing 'significant underestimation' or returning an error instead of falling back to valid block estimates, an issue reported actively affecting downstream users like LDK.
